publicEvidenceClass: sanitized transcription of an interactive live run
rawDirectoryMeaning: Earliest public-safe observations, not byte-for-byte Azure logs
privateSourceRetention: Exact command output and identifiers are retained outside this public repository
publicVerificationBoundary: Repository hashes and evaluators prove internal consistency and change detection; they do not independently authenticate the withheld source
observationTimeBasis: observedAtUtc is the archived client-tool completion time, not a service-side request timestamp
historicalRunSequence: authenticated public request blocked while PNA was Disabled
authenticated private request returned a Chat Completions envelope while PNA was Disabled
authenticated public request returned HTTP 200 after PNA was restored
safeReproductionDelta: The Quick Start adds a private HTTP 200 guard before disabling PNA; that guard is a safety improvement and is not represented as a fourth historical observation
fieldRetentionBoundary: The restored-public observation retained HTTP 200 and the response model, but not generated content, response object, usage, or choice count
